scenes.text: Predict and test an event using repeated fair trials. Record all results and compare the observed frequencies.
Which is more likely: red (10) or blue (6) bottle tops? The answer is red. Compare the counts; 10 red versus 6 blue.
A bag during a reading competition has 8 red and 8 blue bottle tops. Which colour is more likely on one random draw? Pause the video and think.
A bag during a reading competition has 8 red and 8 blue bottle tops. Which colour is more likely on one random draw? The answer is equally likely. Compare the counts; 8 red versus 8 blue.
